notes.title: Open Beta is finally here - Update 0.7
notes.content: [p]Hello dear Menyrians![/p][p][/p][p]We're happy to finally announce that, after months of intense development and optimization,[/p][h1]Open Beta is here![/h1][h1] [/h1][p]What this means for you is that, backer or not, you're finally able to play Menyr with all your friends! All you've got to do is request access to the "playtest" on our Steam page and you'll be in instantly![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44399985/37a207611b0ee53d2e30f3bc69ba74d19363fdd0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Keep in mind this is still a beta test, so we're always testing new features and working on squashing bugs. Participate in the community effort by leaving us feedback on our [url="https://discord.gg/Ewy5bNhDEy"]discord server[/url] and filing bug reports in game![/p][p][/p][p][b][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nogstudio/menyr/posts/4285182"]Read our Kickstarter update here for more details![/url][/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Discretion period is over![/h2][p]You backers and players can now share your creations with the World! We can't wait to see what kind of content you will create in Menyr and would love to see it. Don't hesitate to ping us on our socials or use the [b]#Menyr[/b] when possible so we can find you![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Where do I find other players? Or snippets and maps?[/h3][p]Snippets and maps sharing will be available in the marketplace in-game once it releases. But for now, we have dedicated beta sharing channels in our Discord server. Feel free to join it here so you can find quick and easy to use ressources and talk with like-minded world builders![/p][list][*][p]Join us on our [url="https://discord.gg/Ewy5bNhDEy"]discord server[/url] now![/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3]As a reminder we now have an official Menyr merch store![/h3][p]You can grab some official goodies to support us and rock Menyr's style everywhere to spread the word! Find them here: [url="https://shop.menyr.com/"]https://shop.menyr.com/[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44399985/eb797dcc933821c8633268aaae2795b143585b53.png"][/img][/p][h3]Thank you again for supporting us in this journey![/h3][h3]- See you later in Menyr! [/h3][p][/p][h3]What's new in version 0.7? - Patch notes[/h3][list][*][p]Detailed vegetation implementation,[/p][/*][*][p]Foliage generation feedback,[/p][/*][*][p]Improved vegetation generation speed,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed outline selection color,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed DLSS/FSR loading on startup,[/p][/*][*][p]Added French language support,[/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance,[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced VRAM footprint by about 40%,[/p][/*][*][p]Improved stability,[/p][/*][*][p]Added visual feedback to indicate that an object is being spawned[/p][/*][*][p]Detailed vegetation optimization,[/p][/*][*][p]Route generation fixed (between 1sec & 3sec for full pathfinding),[/p][/*][*][p]Routes save their path. If you wish to regenerate pathfinding, you need to move one of the two pins,[/p][/*][*][p]Spawned resources now clear vegetation,[/p][/*][*][p]Translation settings retained at relaunch,[/p][/*][*][p]Improved handling stability,[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple multiplayer fixes,[/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance,[/p][/*][*][p]Better night rendering in the open world[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a problem where resources were attached to other resources without user input,[/p][/*][*][p]Improved visual rendering,[/p][/*][*][p]Improved dungeon rendering,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some lighting artifacts in the lobby,[/p][/*][*][p]Road optimization,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a performance problem with POIs,[/p][/*][*][p]Improved readability of POI screens,[/p][/*][*][p]Outliner scrolls automatically to display selected asset,[/p][/*][*][p]Improved automatic foliage cleanup on resource spawn,[/p][/*][*][p]Various stability and performance improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various bugs.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Note 0.6.1
notes.content:
Fellow Menyrians, we've just issued Patch 0.6.1 to the closed beta branch. Here's what you can find in it:

[list]
[*] [b]Introducing the ressource outliner[/b]
[*] Faster large selection and large snippet spawn
[*] Points of Interest save fix
[*] Asset snapping improvements
[*] Optimization and various bug fixes
[/list]

[h3]Here's what the new resource outliner will look like in your game. This will allow you to manage large quantities of assets and diverse areas easier around your universes :[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44399985/bb729ee3794d8768e0886cc19211e3b1a4c6e35e.png[/img]

[h3]If you ever find a bug in Menyr, don't forget [url=https://github.com/NOGStudio/Menyr-Bug-Report]you can report it here[/url] so we can take care of it![/h3]

Thanks for playing!

- The Menyr Team

notes.title: Menyr Update 0.6 Available Now!
notes.content:
[h1]🔥 Patch 0.6 – Available Now![/h1]

Dear Menyrians! Thank you for following Menyr's closed beta! 
We have recently uploaded a new kickstarter update! You can check it by clicking [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nogstudio/menyr/posts/4240370]here[/url]!


[h2]Here's a little rundown of the new features you can now test in version 0.6:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Lobbies & Universes: A new interactive hub to manage all your maps in a universe seamlessly.
[*]Dungeon Map Building: Design multi-level dungeons with customizable roofs and automatic roof removal for top-down gameplay.
[*]Snippet Sharing System: Share and discover pre-made assets to speed up worldbuilding.
[*]Retro compatibility: Everything you build from now on will always be compatible with future updates!
[/list]

[h2]📺 Missed Our Live Stream?[/h2]
We showcased all these new features in a recent stream. Catch the highlight montage and full replay right here.
[previewyoutube=c7kR-4cotQc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]🛒 Menyr Goodies Shop is Live![/h2]
Want to support Menyr and grab some awesome merch? The official Menyr shop is now open! Check it out here: [url=https://shop.menyr.com/]https://shop.menyr.com/[/url]

[h3]This is the last major update before Open Beta—get ready! Thanks for being part of this adventure, and we can’t wait to see what you’ll create.
[/h3]

⚔️ Adventure Awaits!
— The Menyr Team

notes.title: Update 0.5 is here!
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

The team has been hard at work since our last update! Along with update 0.5 release last week, our latest kickstarter post tackles some important announcements about our updated roadmap, development challenges, and gives you a bigger insight into version 0.5, update you can download as you read these lines!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nogstudio/menyr/posts/4239924]You can check out the full Kickstart update here![/url]

[h2]📉Development Challenges & Important roadmap Update[/h2]
In 2024, we've definitely had a tough time as a team. Like much of the entertainment industry, we've been hit with lots of uncertainty, and while NOG is still here, we’ve had to push through with a smaller team and fewer resources that have slowed us down. 

But on the upside, Unreal Engine 5.5 and Voxel Plugin 2.0 are coming soon, which will make a huge difference in tackling some technical challenges for Menyr. We’re releasing some builds even if they’re not perfect so you can give us feedback early on—so if you notice things like delayed foliage loading, that’s because we’re waiting on UE 5.5 to handle it. 

[h3]The Early Access launch is now set for February 2025, and we’re excited to keep improving Menyr with all your input along the way.[/h3]

[h2]🚀Current Progress and 0.5 version[/h2]
This update allows for stress-testing the architecture system, introduces new tutorials, improved snapping, and the long-awaited Live Sandcastle feature for real-time terrain sculpting! Check it out and share your feedback with the [url=https://github.com/NOGStudio/Menyr-Feedback]bug report form[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/menyr-951169848094916679]join us on Discord[/url] to give us feedback directly! If all goes well, version 0.6 will be coming soon, with instant foliage, dungeons, and an interactive Lobby.

Thank you again for your support and patience as we continue to create Menyr! Stay tuned for more updates coming soon!

[i]- The Menyr Team[/i]

notes.title: 1st and 2nd Quarters 2024 Update
notes.content:
Hello fellow Menyrians!

The Menyr team is back with a bunch of updates since our last major Update in December. We've got a lot to catch you up on from the first and second quarters of 2024.

In early January, we started strong with the worldbuilding update, including new mountain formations improving the realism of your generated worlds and a sneak peek of the work we've done on the Kickstarter rewards. This update was our way of kicking off the year while also wishing you all a happy new year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44399985/782fff6ef83ef916ceb9776d3257d13ec9ae16f4.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44399985/f185b0b2fb5a54a0f885430847d329092e418e7f.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44399985/1859a6e1d84d1a2354a683c891beff47771f7c02.png[/img]

March was a significant month for us as we finally released the highly anticipated co-op worldbuilding mode to our backers, along with our new, more realistic water system, more believable maps and a new character to play in 3rd person! For this major update, we wanted to guide you through it all with a live Discord stream. You can catch the replay right below. You can see the first version of our new updated UI. 

[previewyoutube=LDI8zR5MrL8;full][/previewyoutube]

Our latest update, posted just last week, teases the next version of Menyr coming in the next couple of weeks. In this version, get ready for:
[list]
[*] The return of old features that were removed for testing, now enhanced!
[*] The highly anticipated Play Mode! It'll come with the basics for playing a DnD game, including measurment tools, dice, grid system, and more.
[*] Game tokens! You'll be able to use 2D images in a flexible and customizable token system. Of course, controlable 3D models are also joining in the fun.
[*] We'll also be expanding beta access soon, allowing people that missed out on our Kickstarter campaign to join us on the journey!
[/list]

Thanks for diving into this update with us! Keep an eye out for more news in the coming weeks as we prepare to unveil the next version of Menyr!

notes.title: Menyr October update: New features and improvements
notes.content:
This October update introduces a new biome and essential improvements:

[b]1. The arrival of the coniferous biome[/b]
Discover the new coniferous environment, characterized by dense pine and fir forests. Give your new maps a mountain feel! For the creation of this biome, specific assets have been designed and are at your disposal. 

[b]2. Expanded outdoor construction palette[/b]
With the addition of a hundred assets dedicated to outdoor construction, set up camps, build walls and diversify your outdoor layouts.

[b]3. Optimizations and fixes[/b]
Various improvements have been made to enhance the stability and fluidity of the generator, offering an improved user experience.

[Important information for the next update:[/b]
The next update will result in an unavoidable loss of data. We encourage the community to anticipate this transition and take full advantage of the new features to come.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: September Update
notes.content:
It's been a little over a month since we released the beta version of Menyr, and the response has been fantastic! We want to give a big shoutout to our backers for their valuable feedback. Your insights have been incredibly helpful in spotting issues we might have missed during our own testing. Performance improvement is a key focus for us, and we're committed to making things even better in the upcoming months. 

Find below the list of features and fixes for this new update.

[h3]
    [b][u] New Features:[/u][/b]
[/h3] 
[list]
[*] Added DLSS 3 support for NVIDIA graphics cards.
[*] Added FSR 2 support for AMD graphics cards.
[*] Introduced a gizmo for object manipulation.
[*] Implemented the ability to select multiple assets simultaneously (CTRL).
[*] Added asset duplication functionality (ALT).
[*] Introduced a consent prompt for data collection on the user's machine.
[*] Added a crash reporter.
[/list]
[h3]
    [u][b] Bug Fixes and Improvements:[/b][/u]
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with seed change during a save.
[*] Added natural foliage to the toolbox.
[*] Improved toolbox loading times.
[*] Fixed river issues during loading.
[*] Addressed menu pause problems.
[*] Fixed snow and rain below sea level.
[*] Overall collision fixes.
[*] Added a confirmation popup for world reset.
[*] Fixed snap to grid functionality.
[*] Overall FPS optimization.
[*] Fixed keybind issues.
[*] Improved visibility of drawn traits for vegetation zone overrides.
[*] Added depth of field.
[*] Removed the toolbar and added a visual indicator for better interaction mode identification.
[*] Introduced a new biome: "Broadleaf forest."
[*] Sea agitation now depends on wind intensity.
[*] Significantly improved bridge stability and reliability.
[*] Fixed crashes related to multiple intersecting rivers.
[*] Added a button to access screenshots taken with the photomode.
[*] Reworked snow that covers the ground and removes leaves from certain trees.
[*] Transitioning from topdown mode to FPS mode now maintains the previous position.
[*] Further collision fixes.
[*] Borderless and windowed modes release the mouse when the application is visible.
[/list]
